title: Bozeman cattle mutilation with UFO reports

tellings.quote: And there was a cattle mutilation, in which two cows were killed and surgically manipulated.

plain: A scientist named Kevin Knuth says that around 1988, near Bozeman, Montana, there was a cattle mutilation, where two cows were found killed and, in his words, surgically manipulated. According to the story's title, there were also reports of UFOs in the area at the time. Tellers raise cases like this because they suggest the strange lights and the dead animals may be connected.
